title: Fully local Reshetikhin-Turaev theories
summary: Completing an arc of research initiated by Reshetikhin--Turaev and Witten, we construct fully local 3-dimensional topological field theories from non-degenerate braided fusion categories. We do so by defining a symmetric tensor enhancement $\mathrm{E}\mathbb{F}$ with full duals of the 3-category $\mathbb{F}$ of fusion categories, in which every Reshetikhin--Turaev theory has a point generator.
